lines.text: We have some time before dinner. What can we do?
lines.speaker: Mao

lines.text: How about a short walk by the river?
lines.speaker: June

lines.text: That sounds nice. Which path should we take?
lines.speaker: Mao

lines.text: Let's take the path behind the coffee shop.
lines.speaker: June

lines.text: Do we have time to walk all the way to the bridge?
lines.speaker: Mao

lines.text: Yes, but let's leave at six so we have enough time.
lines.speaker: June

lines.text: Okay. Shall we meet outside the coffee shop first?
lines.speaker: Mao

lines.text: Yes, I'll see you there at six.
lines.speaker: June
